production_mux_route.release_rule: The candidate is an electrical reference only until exact live stock or an explicit pre-order/private-library/global-sourcing route, MOQ and price are timestamped together.

sdio_pullups.location: direct SDIO branch and deterministic JTAG-source strap
FSUSB42 HSD2+ SDIO-only branch; disconnected from C5 during USB service

sdio_clock_bias.reason: SDIO requires pull-ups on CMD and DAT0..DAT3; CLK is actively driven by the host and remains unbiased. Its independent series tuning footprint remains fitted.

usb_series.location: FSUSB42 HSD1+ USB-only branch after connector-side ESD
FSUSB42 HSD1- USB-only branch after connector-side ESD

layout_rules: USB and SDIO series footprints are branch-local and are never placed on the C5 common segment shared by GPIO13/GPIO14.
DAT2/DAT3 pull-ups stay on HSD2 so they cannot bias USB D+/D- in service mode.
CLK has no fitted pull-up; keep only a DNP diagnostic footprint and the independent series tuning footprint.
Route each differential USB branch as 90-ohm differential and length-match within the final stack-up rule; avoid stubs at the mux.
Place every source-series option close to the active source for the direction being qualified; bidirectional SDIO values are finalized by SI/HIL, not assumed from schematic alone.

edge_straps.selected_profile: rising-edge input sample, falling-edge output drive
edge_straps.jtag_policy: GPIO7 is externally pulled high for SDIO. Production eFuse and recovery policy must use USB-JTAG or disabled JTAG and must never depend on a floating GPIO7 or a conflicting pad-JTAG strap.

service_vbus.hardware_requirement: An always-on hardware detector and asynchronous latch must seize service ownership without C5 or Hub firmware.

latch.clear_condition: service VBUS absent AND C5 EN asserted low AND Hub SDIO pins proven high-impedance AND explicit AON service-release request
service_override: force C5 EN low during switch
force mux OE high during branch change

ownership.power_on_default: SERVICE_USB branch selected; C5 and Hub remain reset until the always-on sequencer has sampled service VBUS and established one legal state.

runtime_to_service: asynchronously latch C5_SERVICE_OWNED when service VBUS is detected
assert C5 EN low and Hub RUN low; deny all Hub SDIO output enables and prove the Hub pins high-impedance
drive mux OE high to disconnect both HSD branches
wait at least 1 microsecond, exceeding FSUSB42 turn-off and break-before-make maxima
drive mux SEL low for HSD1 USB
wait at least 1 microsecond, then drive mux OE low
establish all C5 boot and SDIO-edge strap levels
release C5 EN only; keep Hub RUN low and strap levels stable for at least 3 milliseconds
service_to_runtime: require service VBUS absent and assert C5 EN low
keep Hub SDIO pins high-impedance while releasing Hub RUN and entering the ownership stub
drive mux OE high and wait at least 1 microsecond
drive mux SEL high for HSD2 SDIO and wait at least 1 microsecond
drive mux OE low while both endpoints remain non-driving
apply GPIO25 high, GPIO3 low and GPIO7 high strap levels, then release C5 EN
hold strap levels for at least 3 milliseconds and initialize C5 SDIO slave
train at 20 MHz before enabling Hub drive; target 40 MHz only after the HIL gates pass
illegal: changing SEL while C5 or Hub can drive GPIO13/GPIO14
letting firmware clear C5_SERVICE_OWNED while VBUS is present
using service VBUS as a power source

performance.rule: 20 MHz is bring-up only. The 7.5 MB/s payload floor is accepted only at the 40 MHz target after reset, coexistence and long-run HIL.

hil_gates: USB enumerate, flash, reset and recovery with Hub held reset and every non-muxed SDIO signal externally pulled to a legal idle
hot insertion and removal of service VBUS from every runtime state without contention, back-power or loss of recovery ownership
CMD52/CMD53, CRC7/CRC16, DAT1 interrupt, turnaround and reset recovery at 20 MHz before 40 MHz
at least 7.5 MB/s framed payload at 40 MHz with control priority under simultaneous C5 radio load
USB Full-Speed eye/edge compliance through the selected production mux and final PCB stack-up
GPIO3/GPIO25/GPIO7 strap readback, eFuse policy and wrong-image recovery across temperature and supply corners
24-to-48-hour soak with repeated service seizure and release; no C5/Hub bus contention or stuck ownership

required_later_integration: replace the historical one-bit C5 map in the atomic G2F/KiCad source after H0-R2 acceptance
bind Hub-side DAT0..DAT3/CMD/CLK to the accepted dual-RP pin map without changing this C5 physical assignment
select and live-validate the service-VBUS detector/latch implementation and production mux route
promote 40 MHz target semantics into the top-level H0 transport contract after HIL readiness review
